Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.player.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
The player's tribe is the collection of character and building cards acquired during the game. Exposes counting and scoring methods used by events, buildings, and the final score calculation. Contains no game logic
